purpose: Backward candidate mechanism and scientific equations; not a continuum-QED or campaign-closure claim
idea: A filled negative hopping band and one extra physical-spin CAR excitation move through links whose phase is a quantum coordinate. Interband virtual electron-hole excitations and the same hopping current reshape the quantum field spectrum and nonforward response. Propagation and interaction are consumers of one exact joint Hamiltonian rather than unrelated formula fits.

equations.H: H(phi)=sum_m omega_m(a_m^dagger a_m+1/2)-sum_edge,spin t_edge[exp(i(phi_edge+g sum_m b_edge,m Q_m)) c^dagger_target,spin c_source,spin + h.c.]
equations.Q: Q_m=(a_m+a_m^dagger)/sqrt(2), represented in an explicitly finite oscillator basis; exp(i g b.Q) is evaluated exactly in that basis
equations.mode_embedding: b_edge,m=Re integral_edge epsilon_m dot dx exp(i q_m dot x); both mode polarizations are transverse to their named q_m
equations.T: T_edge,spin=-t_edge exp(i phi_edge) kron(c^dagger_target,spin c_source,spin, exp(i g b_edge.Q))
equations.Gamma: Gamma_direction(z;0)=-d G_phi(z)^(-1)/ds at phi=s direction; executable central finite derivative includes exact reference-state relaxation and all addition/removal/photon sectors; reported O(step^2), static-source only
equations.retarded: R_ab(z)=sum_n <0|Oa|n><n|Ob|0>/(z-Delta_n)-<0|Ob|n><n|Oa|0>/(z+Delta_n); z=omega+i eta, eta>0. This fixes current and coordinate tensors including negative-frequency branches.
equations.G: Gij(z)=sum_N6 <0|ci|n><n|cj^dagger|0>/(z-(En-E0)) + sum_N4 <0|cj^dagger|n><n|ci|0>/(z+(En-E0)); all sectors include the identical dynamic photons and Peierls law
equations.feedback: Sigma(z)=G0(z)^(-1)-G(z)^(-1), Pi(z)=D0(z)^(-1)-D(z)^(-1); hence G=(G0^-1-Sigma)^-1 and D=(D0^-1-Pi)^-1. G0,D0 refer to g=0 ground-state family on the same finite module. These are exact implicit self-energy definitions, NOT an independently derived RPA closure or continuum self-consistency theorem. Full diagonalization of the common H supplies both tensors.
equations.nonforward_scattering: T_fi= <f| C(out*,in)+J(out*)[Ei+omega_in-H+i eta]^-1 J(in)+J(in)[Ei-omega_out-H+i eta]^-1 J(out*) |i>; omega_out=omega_in-(Ef-Ei). Comes from source expansion of this H; not a reused QED cross-section formula.
equations.normalization: Ground and each receiver eigenvector norm1; finite CAR sources canonical. Unit incident polarization amplitudes; reported |T|^2 is a finite-source response weight, not a continuum area/cross-section with missing photon flux factors. Up/down current matrix labels which physical spin species carries each vertex; it is NOT a spin-flip electron S-matrix.
equations.pairs: Bare 8-orbital one-body h has spin-double bands +/-1.65,+/-0.35. Reference sea fills 4 negative-energy orbitals. In N=5, Nplus-1 counts real interband particle-hole excitations relative to that reference. Full 24-dimensional Nup3,Ndown2 CAR sector retains every allowed pair channel, not a one-pair or frozen-valence truncation. These holes are NOT a derivation of relativistic positrons.

units.J_convention: number-phase conjugate current; physical negative-electron charge current is -J

state: Lowest exact coupled H eigenstate in Nup=3,Ndown=2, total charge -1 relative to N4 sea; physical Sz=+1/2. Spin-independent hopping conserves spin; no invented magnetic moment or spin-orbit term.
receiver: Selected exact coupled same-sector eigenvectors with positive outgoing frequency; energy transfer includes actual matter/pair/field excitation. Anchored square means no claim of exact continuum momentum-conserving recoil or free asymptotic photons.
